denominator_glossary.n_unique_units_global: Total number of unique unit keys (session_id, unit_axis_index) evaluated across all processed sessions.
denominator_glossary.n_unique_units_by_session: Number of unique unit records within a specific recording session.
denominator_glossary.n_raw_behavioral_trials: Number of raw behavioral trials recorded in a single condition session file.
denominator_glossary.n_unit_trial_observations: Sum of trials accumulated across all evaluated units and conditions (unit-condition-trial exposures).
denominator_glossary.n_long_metric_rows_total: Total number of rows in the long-format metrics database (unit_response_metrics_long.csv).
denominator_glossary.n_primary_contrast_rows: Number of rows in the long-format database representing primary statistical contrast tests.
denominator_glossary.n_nonprimary_or_auxiliary_metric_rows: Number of rows in the long-format database representing auxiliary/hypothesis metrics without primary statistical contrast tests.
denominator_glossary.n_unit_candidate_label_rows: Total number of unique candidate label rows in the unit candidate labels database (unit_candidate_labels.csv).
